name: Staff of Rigor
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 298
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 298
Aura moderate varies CL 8th
Slot none; Price 20,800 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This iron-shod wood staff allows use of the following spells:
Bane (1 charge)
Cause fear (1 charge)
Command (1 charge)
Magic weapon (1 charge)
Align weapon (2 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, align weapon, bane, cause fear, command, magic weapon; Cost 10,400 gp
